back_translation: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of the LORD their God, which the LORD their God had sent him to tell them—all these words—

Azariah son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, You are speaking falsely. The LORD our God has not sent you to say, You shall not go to Egypt to reside there.
Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, so that they may kill us and exile us to Babylon.
So Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces and all the people did not obey the voice of the LORD to stay in the land of Judah.
Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the whole remnant of Judah who had returned to the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been scattered—

the men, the women, the children, the king's daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah—
and they entered the land of Egypt, because they did not obey the voice of the LORD, and they came as far as Tahpanhes.
Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes, saying:
Take in your hand large stones and bury them in the mortar of the brick pavement at the entrance of Pharaoh's palace at Tahpanhes, in the sight of the Jews,

and say to them, This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, my servant, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have buried, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
And he will come and strike the land of Egypt: whoever is destined for death, to death; whoever for captivity, to captivity; and whoever for the sword, to the sword.

And I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn them and carry them off; and he will wrap the land of Egypt around himself as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there in peace.
And he will break the sacred pillars of Beth-shemesh (the temple of the sun), which is in the land of Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt with fire.
